mechanism: Real model emitted retrieve_knowledge decisions without required query_text field when harmonic analysis was invalid/unvoiced. Runtime _parse_agent_decision raised PlannerOutputError; error entered recoverable_errors; three retries repeated same structural failure; termination max_planner_retries with status error.
recommended_fix: Option B — allow direct inconclusive without retrieve_knowledge (v9.1)
